content.value: A perfectly insulated system contains 0.06 m3 of hydrogen, at 24°C and 550 kPa, which 13 receives an input of paddle work at constant pressure until the temperature is 66 °C. Determine (i) the heat Q, (ii) the change of internal energy, flU, (iii) the work input, and (iv) the change of entropy, tss.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
